tasks.title: Product Repository Ports
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Application P2-P6 services depend on engine-neutral repository protocols, not InMemory concrete types.

tasks.title: SQLite Desktop Product Adapters
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Desktop adapters persist governed P2-P6 products in frozen 1.6.0 tables with exact historical reads and restart durability.

tasks.title: PostgreSQL Service Product Adapters
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Service adapters implement the same ports and frozen 1.6.0 semantics without driver leakage into Application.

tasks.title: Object and Parquet Store Durability
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Logical object URIs are staged, byte-verified, immutably sealed, listable for recovery, and never expose physical paths as product identity.

tasks.title: Publication Transaction and CAS
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Publication follows compute/staging/validate/seal/DB transaction/release registration/CAS with explicit idempotency and fail-closed conflicts.

tasks.title: Restart Durability
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Exact products remain readable after repository/process restart and no production authority depends on process-local state.

tasks.title: Crash and Orphan Recovery
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Interrupted staging is reclaimable, sealed-but-unregistered objects are detected deterministically, and registered immutable objects are never deleted.

tasks.title: SQLite PostgreSQL Logical Parity and Qualification
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Both engines project logically equivalent exact identities and B2 qualifies under the existing exactly-14-job Hosted CI topology.
